findings.claim: Task 3.2 is not satisfied because the verification file does not record the independent review findings.
findings.evidence: Acceptance criterion 3.2 requires: "Then run an independent review with the `artifact-critic` subagent or `adversarial-review --mode diff`, and record its findings in the same file"; the diff adds only the empty heading `## Independent review` at the end of `openspec/changes/chat-persistence-durability/verification.md` with no findings recorded under it.
findings.suggested_fix: Populate the `## Independent review` section with the review command/subagent used, findings, dispositions, and re-review result, or mark the criterion unmet.

findings.claim: Repository state violates the blocking no-env-files constraint because environment files are present in the project tree.
findings.evidence: Constraint `no-env-files-committed` says `.env and .env.*.local must never be committed (only .env.example)`; `file_tree` lists `./.env` and `./.env.development.local`.
findings.suggested_fix: Remove `.env` and `.env.development.local` from tracked files if committed, keep only `.env.example`, and add ignore coverage as needed.
